basic_profile.bio: Based in Lisbon, Portugal, I'm a 34-year-old software developer who has a deep interest in philosophy, particularly Stoicism. My journey with anxiety has profoundly shaped my perspective on life, making me appreciate the smaller things every day. I'm a night owl, often active during late hours, and I try to balance my work life with time spent in nature. Currently, I'm single, finding peace in solitude and self-discovery. I enjoy discussing technology trends, and I'm passionate about creating a supportive online community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, my expertise lies in software development and tech innovation. I am self-taught in meditation and mindfulness practices, having explored these areas extensively to manage my own mental health. My knowledge of Stoicism comes from years of reading and participating in relevant forums and discussions.
